summary: Strict-mode import refuses to mutate when the pp_created ledger cannot be opened, so imported fixtures stay recoverable by pp-cleanup.
reason: trust-mode=strict exists so agents can recover fixtures they create. A bulk import that continues after a ledger-open failure would create remote issues with no local records.
validated_outcome: Import with --trust-mode strict and an unwritable --db path aborts before issueCreate.
